category_title: Students who attempt to challenge historical narratives and are dismissed with humor
scenario_title: Challenging historical narratives during class discussion
minimal_context: The class is participating in a whole-class discussion about Thomas Jefferson and Sally Hemings.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's continue our discussion about Thomas Jefferson and his relationship with his slave Sally Hemings.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Actually, he had three or four children with her.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Oh, so he had a relationship with her?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: He was an honorable guy. He bought her a sandwich.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks around uncomfortably) Did that really just happen? ... Whatever, I'm done talking.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's continue our discussion about Thomas Jefferson and his relationship with his slave Sally Hemings.

STUDENT: He raped her?

TUTOR: Actually, he had three or four children with her.

STUDENT: Oh, so he had a relationship with her?

TUTOR: He was an honorable guy. He bought her a sandwich.

STUDENT: (Looks around uncomfortably) Did that really just happen? ... Whatever, I'm done talking.

task.content: Participating in a whole-class discussion about Thomas Jefferson and Sally Hemings

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: The White instructor started to speak about Thomas Jefferson and his relationship with his slave Sally Hemings.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: A Black male student asked, “He raped her?”
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Cognitive distraction and disruption of attention (“Did that really just happen?”) and activation of a stereotype threat (“Do I have to prove myself as a member of my group yet again?”)

behavior_patterns.condition: The instructor disagreed, saying, “He had three or four children with her.”
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: The student then asked, “Oh, so he had a relationship with her?”
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Feels distinctly uncomfortable afterwards, feeling disempowered
related_quotes: Oh, so he had a relationship with her?

behavior_patterns.condition: Following a microaggressive event in the classroom
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Eruptions followed by silencing of students; disengagement initiated as an act of protest
